brief.topic: Storage and lifecycle substrate candidates for ZKnowledgeCompounding (T1.1 data-model carrier, T1.2 lifecycle/decay modeling, T1.3 local-first vs server): relational+vector, embedded graph, bitemporal/immutable, CRDT local-first sync, versioned knowledge graph

criteria.question: What is the storage and data model (relational, graph, document, triple, vector)?
Does it support bitemporal, system-versioned, time-travel, or commit-history versioning?
Is it embedded / in-process / offline-capable / self-hostable?
Does one store provide both graph traversal and vector/embedding search?
Does it model decay, TTL, retention, or knowledge lifecycle semantics?
What is the deployment model and license?
Does it provide sync, replication, CRDT merge, or partial replication?
